blocks.text: Building champions on and off the field

Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is proud to be a member of the Alabama High School Athletic Association (AHSAA) and to continue growing our athletics program for students in grades 6th–12th. Through competitive sports, our student-athletes are challenged to develop both physically and spiritually while representing our school with excellence.

Under the leadership of our Athletic Director, we are expanding and strengthening a dynamic athletics program that emphasizes teamwork, discipline, sportsmanship, and Christ-like character. Our goal is to provide opportunities for students to compete, grow in their God-given talents, and build lasting relationships both on and off the field.
Be a part of something extraordinary.
Athletics at Kingdom Heights is more than just competition—it’s about developing the whole student . Our program emphasizes:

items: Teamwork: Students learn to work together, support one another, and celebrate shared victories.
Discipline: Through training and competition, athletes develop habits of perseverance, time management, and personal responsibility.
Character Formation: Every practice, game, and competition is rooted in Christian values, teaching students to compete with humility, integrity, and grace.
Physical Wellness: Sports promote healthy habits, physical fitness, and mental resilience—skills that benefit students long after the final whistle.

blocks.text: Help us shape the future of youth athletics in Huntsville.
We Need Your Help: Get Involved!

As we build our athletics program, we’re calling on parents , alumni , and community members to partner with us . From coaching and team management to event coordination and fundraising , there are countless ways to support this exciting new initiative .

items: Coaching: Share your skills by leading a team or assisting with practices
Team Support: Help with snacks , uniform distribution , and game-day logistics
Fundraising: Assist with spirit nights , sponsorship outreach , and athletic events
Facilities: Help us prepare fields , courts , and equipment for upcoming seasons
